name: Profane
detailed_description:
PROFANE – Do You Dare Challenge the Unknown?

You are a skeptic investigator, determined to debunk urban legends and paranormal cases. But what if some of these stories are true?

Profane is a psychological horror game with multiple chapters, each taking you and up to 3 friends, into cursed, long-abandoned places where reality starts to blur.

Whether you face the darkness alone or with your team, your mission is to prove it’s all superstition. But as the nightmares unfold, you’ll begin to wonder if some truths were never meant to be uncovered.

With intense jumpscares, disturbing mysteries, and shocking plot twists, Profane challenges your sanity as you explore haunted locations and try to escape with your life.

FEATURES:

👁️ Psychological horror at its finest – The tension rises with every case, whether solo or in co-op.
👻 Unpredictable jumpscares – Silence is never safe.
🔎 Paranormal cases based on real legends – Each chapter reveals a chilling new story.
🕵️ Investigate, survive, and uncover the truth – But be careful: some things are better left buried.
🎮 Solo or Co-op (1–4 players) – Explore alone for a classic horror experience, or bring friends and face the unknown together.
🩸 A story full of twists – What you believe may be your downfall.
